standard.summary: 轻量训练安全防护层，实时监控 loss 是否出现 NaN/Inf 或异常 spike，并可自动降低学习率或中止训练，防止训练崩溃。
standard.effect: 开启后每 N 步检查一次 loss，发现 NaN/Inf 或大幅跳升时触发干预策略（降 LR 或提前停止）。不影响正常训练速度，检查开销极低。
standard.whenToUse: 推荐长时间无人值守训练时开启，或使用较激进学习率时作为保险。对新角色/新数据集调参阶段特别有用。
standard.avoidWhen: 不需要关闭。SafeGuard 本身对训练速度影响极小，可常驻开启。

standard_en.summary: A lightweight training safety layer that watches in real time for NaN/Inf or an abnormal spike in the loss and can lower the learning rate or abort training automatically, so the run does not collapse.
standard_en.effect: With this on, the loss is checked every N steps, and a NaN/Inf or a large jump triggers the intervention (lowering the LR or stopping early). It does not affect normal training speed; the check costs almost nothing.
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended for long unattended runs, or as insurance when you use a fairly aggressive learning rate. Especially useful while tuning for a new character or a new dataset.
standard_en.avoidWhen: There is no need to turn it off. SafeGuard's own effect on training speed is minimal, so it can stay on permanently.

advanced.principle: 每隔 nan_check_interval 步在 loss 值上执行 torch.isnan/isinf 检查，并维护一个 loss_window_size 大小的滑动窗口检测 spike（当前 loss 超过窗口均值 × spike_threshold 倍判定为 spike）。
advanced.intervention: 三档干预：NaN/Inf 计数超 max_nan_count → 停止；spike → 可选自动降低 LR（系数 lr_reduction_factor）；gradients 扫描模式（batched/foreach/legacy）控制梯度异常检测的 CUDA 同步策略。
advanced.expectedImpact: 正常训练不受影响；发生 NaN 爆炸时及时止损，避免浪费整个训练 run。
advanced.tradeoffs: 每步多一次 loss tensor 检查（几乎无开销）；自动降 LR 会改变训练轨迹，若 loss 抖动属正常范围应适当调高 spike_threshold。

advanced_en.principle: Every nan_check_interval steps it runs torch.isnan/isinf checks on the loss value and maintains a sliding window of loss_window_size to detect spikes (the current loss exceeding the window mean × spike_threshold counts as a spike).
advanced_en.intervention: Three intervention tiers: NaN/Inf count above max_nan_count → stop; spike → optional automatic LR reduction (factor lr_reduction_factor); the gradients scan mode (batched/foreach/legacy) controls the CUDA sync strategy for gradient anomaly detection.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Normal training is unaffected; when a NaN explosion happens it stops the bleeding promptly, saving the whole run.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: One extra loss tensor check per step (nearly free); auto LR reduction changes the training trajectory, so if the loss jitter is within the normal range raise spike_threshold appropriately.
